note: The play language is open: any BCP-47-shaped tag a player names is a play language, and nothing in the product validates membership, authors a table for it, or guesses it from text. This file holds only `default`, the tag a host or kernel falls back to when a session carries none, and `suggested`, the tags a language picker offers first (free text is always accepted). Words reach a tag by projection: `content/ui/en/` is the one authored source, `content/ui/<tag>/` is an optional shipped seed of that projection, and the presenter lane produces every other tag on first use (contract §23, 2026-09-09).
